_doc: Math Lab — example config. Copy to config.json and customize. Both .env and config.json are gitignored.
_doc_models: STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: leave the `models` block out and route through Podbit via `podbit.url` below. Podbit owns model assignment, semaphore-based concurrency, rate-limit cooldowns, budget tracking, and per-subsystem prompt/temperature config. Putting an apiKey here bypasses ALL of that and is the wrong path for any persistent install.
_doc_recommended_setup: 1. Run Podbit with your model registry configured (Models page). 2. Assign a model to the `lab:math-lab` subsystem on the Models page. 3. Set PODBIT_URL in math-lab/.env to point at your Podbit API (default http://localhost:4710). 4. Delete or comment out the entire `models` block below. 5. Done — every codegen call now flows through Podbit's semaphore.

podbit._doc: When set, lab-core routes ALL LLM calls through Podbit's /api/llm/call proxy. The `subsystem` is the model registry assignment slot — assign a model to it on the Podbit Models page. With this configured, the `models` block below can be removed entirely.

specTypes.math: Pure numerical computation using standard math libraries (numpy, scipy, sympy, mpmath). Verify mathematical identities, evaluate expressions, compare computed constants. NOT for: simulations requiring domain-specific packages, ML training, quantum computing, or anything needing libraries beyond standard scientific Python.
specTypes.parameter_sweep: Sweep a mathematical parameter across a range using standard math libraries. The function being swept must be expressible as pure Python math — no ML frameworks, no physics engines, no domain simulators. Good for: testing how a formula behaves across a range. NOT for: training models at different hyperparameters.
specTypes.convergence_analysis: Test whether a mathematically-defined series, sequence, or iterative formula converges. Must be expressible as a closed-form or simple recursive computation. NOT for: empirical convergence of training algorithms or simulations.
specTypes.curve_shape: Analyze the shape of a mathematically-defined function (monotonicity, extrema, inflection points, bounds). The function must be computable from a formula. NOT for: empirical curves from data or simulations.

_doc_models_block: FALLBACK ONLY — uncomment if you cannot route through Podbit (e.g. standalone smoke test, CI without a Podbit instance). Hits the provider directly with no semaphore, no budget, no rate-limit cooldown. NEVER commit a real apiKey here — the file is gitignored locally but using env vars is safer (LLM_API_KEY / EVAL_LLM_API_KEY override the apiKey field).
